components.css: .ds-preview{font-family:Hanken, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#292735);}.ds-preview button{font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;transition:background .18s ease,color .18s ease}.ds-preview button:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}.ds-preview button:focus-visible,.ds-preview input:focus-visible,.ds-preview a:focus-visible,.ds-preview [tabindex]:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#6746ad);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-preview svg{width:20px;height:20px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex-shrink:0}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-preview *{transition:none!important}}.ds-speech-text{display:block;width:100%;min-height:240px;resize:vertical;border:1px solid #c7bed5;background:var(--white,#fff);color:var(--ink,#292735);border-radius:7px;padding:16px;font-family:inherit;font-size:16px;line-height:1.75;caret-color:var(--accent,#6746ad)}.ds-speech-text::placeholder{color:var(--muted,#696573)}.ds-speech-voice{width:100%;min-height:44px;border:1px solid #c7bed5;color:var(--ink,#292735);background:var(--white,#fff);border-radius:6px;padding:10px;font-family:inherit;font-size:13px}.ds-speech-text:focus-visible,.ds-speech-voice:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#6746ad);outline-offset:3px}.ds-preview label{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;margin:12px 0 10px}

narrative.overview:
A polished, Wispr-like notebook with a cool lavender rail, white writing surfaces, graphite text and deep violet actions. The user chose this familiar notebook persona; retain its quiet, compact controls and generous writing area.

Speech creation shares the same paper, controls and supporting explanations as transcription. Typography and tonal separation supply the hierarchy; decoration stays subordinate to the words.
keyCharacteristics: Lavender navigation surrounding a white writing surface.
Compact controls, generous transcript line spacing and restrained separators.
One shared visual vocabulary for recording, importing and creating speech.

rules.name: The Violet Action Rule
rules.body: Use deep violet for actions, selection and focus; reserve rose for recording and error states.

rules.name: The Writing Space Rule
rules.body: Give transcripts room to breathe; keep supporting labels compact and muted.

rules.name: The Quiet Depth Rule
rules.body: Separate sheets with tone and thin borders; reserve soft shadows for selected navigation and the microphone.

dos: Do reuse the lavender rail, white notebook and violet action pairing.
Do retain explicit focus outlines, reduced-motion support and real status labels.
Do use the existing muted color for secondary text, including format extensions.
Do let mobile navigation form a two-column grid and keep the writing surface full width.
donts: Don't add a separate visual identity for speech creation.
Don't imply fabricated live activity, summaries or unavailable capabilities.
Don't turn the writing surface into a stack of heavily shadowed cards.
